story.titleZh: 梅基耶盛赞哈贾尔复出登台「非常出色」：比赛时的冷静与情绪控制令人印象深刻
story.summaryZh: 红牛领队洛朗·梅基耶称，伊萨克·哈贾尔伤愈复出的巴库周末「非常出色，真的非常出色」：最重要的是他一上车就感觉良好、没有疼痛；巴库容错空间极小，并不容易，但他「一节接一节，非常冷静、带着很多正能量」地找回节奏，排位第四、正赛第三。
story.originalTitle: 'It was outstanding' – Laurent Mekies praises Isack Hadjar's Azerbaijan Grand Prix podium on Red Bull return
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上以令人印象深刻的表现重返F1。
洛朗·梅基耶盛赞伊萨克·哈贾尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上的表现「非常出色」，这位红牛车手从手腕伤势中复出便登上了领奖台。
哈贾尔在夏休期间受伤后首次亮相，尽管在巴库练习赛中稳扎稳打地建立信心，但他在排位赛中拿到了令人印象深刻的第四。
这还意味着他排在红牛队友马克斯·维斯塔潘之前发车。虽然他在比赛开头几圈让一路追来的荷兰人超了过去，但哈贾尔一直跟住这位四届世界冠军，并在比赛末段奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在1号弯失误后升至第三。
「我觉得伊萨克这个周末的表现非常出色。」领队梅基耶说。
「真的非常出色。首先，最重要的是他一上车就感觉很好，没有疼痛。过去几周我们每次碰面都说，我们要等伊萨克百分之百恢复再回来，因为那是首要任务。
「尽管如此，即使没有疼痛，这也不是一条容易回归的赛道，因为这里没有任何容错空间。而他一节接一节地建立起自己的节奏，非常冷静，充满能量——充满正能量。」
除了复出之外，哈贾尔还被确认2027年将继续留在红牛。在第二个赛季里，这位法国车手的速度稳步提升，其中包括在摩纳哥登上领奖台。
梅基耶承认，哈贾尔在周六巴库正赛中的冷静尤其令他印象深刻——哈贾尔当时在无线电中坚持表示，他不想和维斯塔潘缠斗，以免影响两人的比赛。
「这说明这孩子比赛有多聪明，他在车里正在发展出多强的思考能力，以及他能做到多好的情绪控制。」梅基耶说。
「在所有这些方面，除了跑出更快的速度之外，还有很多迹象表明他取得了进步。
「所以，正是这样的成长轨迹，从他加入车队以来每天都让我们印象深刻。去年可能也是如此。
「这也是我们希望为他提供尽可能好的环境、让他继续进步的原因，因为他这一步的进步确实令人印象深刻。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Isack Hadjar returned to Formula 1 with an impressive performance during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Laurent Mekies has praised Isack Hadjar’s performance in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as “outstanding”, after the Red Bull driver returned from a wrist injury to claim a podium.

Hadjar made his first appearance since sustaining the injury during the summer break, and despite a steady start during practice in Baku to build up confidence, took an impressive fourth in Qualifying.

It also included starting ahead of Red Bull team mate Max Verstappen, and although he let the charging Dutchman through in the opening laps, Hadjar stayed with the four-time World Champion, eventually moving up to third after Oscar Piastri made a mistake at Turn 1 in the closing stages.
“I think it was outstanding what Isack has produced this weekend,” said Team Principal Mekies.

“Really outstanding. At first, the most important thing is that he felt straight away good in the car, no pain. Every time that we met together in the last few weeks we said we will wait for Isack to come back at 100%, because that's the priority.

“Nonetheless, even without pain, it's not an easy track to go back to, because of the no margin for error. And he has been building up his rhythms, session after session, very calmly, with a lot of energy – with a lot of positive energy.”

As well as making his return, Hadjar was also confirmed as being retained by Red Bull for 2027 after a sophomore season where the Frenchman has steadily improved his pace, which includes a podium in Monaco.
Mekies admits he was particularly impressed by Hadjar's calmness during Saturday's race in Baku, after insisting over the radio he didn't want to fight Verstappen and compromise both their races.
“It shows you how cleverly the kid is racing, and how much of brain capacity he is developing while in the car, and how much emotion control he is managing to have," said Mekies.
"And [there are] many indicators of steps he has made in all these areas, on top of producing more speed.
“So it's exactly that trajectory that has been impressing us every day since he has joined the team. Probably last year as well.
"And that's also there that we want to give him the best possible environment for him to continue to develop, because that step was truly impressive.”
Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/it-was-outstanding-mekies-praises-hadjars-azerbaijan-gp-podium-on-return.5suUJmpAuHzbzrUe5SzELk

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
